tools.description: Use preview first when you need to discover paid APIs by capability without paying or contacting seller endpoints. tools.name: validate
tools.description: Use validate for an unpaid readiness check of one concrete HTTPS seller endpoint already listed in the local catalog, for example a URL returned by preview. It compares claimed and observed payment/readiness information and returns flags; it does not purchase the service or add a routing observation
